160 /** 161 * A templated method to retrieve the record data as a certain type T. For example, if record data is 4B long 162 * (integer) then this method should be used as getValueAs() and it will return the record data as an integer.
163 * Notice this return value is a copy of the data, not a pointer to the actual data 164 * @param[in] offset The offset in the record data to start reading the value from. Useful for cases when you want 165 * to read some of the data that doesn't start at offset 0. This is an optional parameter and the default value 166 * is 0, meaning start reading the value at the beginning of the record data 167 * @return The record data as type T 168 */ 169 template 170 T getValueAs(size_t offset = 0) const 171 { 172 if (getDataSize() - offset < sizeof(T)) 173 return 0; 174 175 T result; 176 memcpy(&result, m_Data->recordValue + offset, sizeof(T)); 177 return result; 178 } 179 180 /** 181 * A templated method to copy data of type T into the TLV record data. For example: if record data is 4[Bytes] long use 182 * this method with \ to set an integer value into the record data: setValue(num) 183 * @param[in] newValue The value of type T to copy to the record data 184 * @param[in] valueOffset An optional parameter that specifies where to start setting the record data (default set to 0). For example: 185 * if record data is 20 bytes long and you only need to set the 4 last bytes as integer then use this method like this: 186 * setValue(num, 16) 187 * @return True if value was set successfully or false if the size of T is larger than the record data size 188 */ 189 template 190 bool setValue(T newValue, int valueOffset = 0) 191 { 192 if (getDataSize() < sizeof(T)) 193 return false; 194 195 memcpy(m_Data->recordValue + valueOffset, &newValue, sizeof(T)); 196 return true; 197 } 198 199 /** 200 * @return The total size of the TLV record (in bytes) 201 */ 202 virtual size_t getTotalSize() const = 0; 203 204 /** 205 * @return The size of the record value (meaning the size of the 'V' part in TLV) 206 */ 207 virtual size_t getDataSize() const = 0; 208 }; 209 210 211 /** 212 * @class TLVRecordReader 213 * A class for reading TLV records data out of a byte stream. This class contains helper methods for retrieving and 214 * counting TLV records. This is a template class that expects template argument class derived from TLVRecord. 215 */ 216 template 217 class TLVRecordReader 218 { 219 private: 220 mutable size_t m_RecordCount; 221 222 public: 223 224 /** 225 * A default c'tor for this class 226 */ 227 TLVRecordReader() { m_RecordCount = (size_t)-1; } 228 229 /** 230 * A default copy c'tor for this class 231 */ 232 TLVRecordReader(const TLVRecordReader& other) 233 { 234 m_RecordCount = other.m_RecordCount; 235 } 236 237 /** 238 * A d'tor for this class which currently does nothing 239 */ 240 virtual ~TLVRecordReader() { } 241 242 /** 243 * Overload of the assignment operator for this class 244 * @param[in] other The TLVRecordReader instance to assign 245 */ 246 TLVRecordReader& operator=(const TLVRecordReader& other) 247 { 248 m_RecordCount = other.m_RecordCount; 249 return *this; 250 } 251 252 /** 253 * Get the first TLV record out of a byte stream 254 * @param[in] tlvDataBasePtr A pointer to the TLV data byte stream 255 * @param[in] tlvDataLen The TLV data byte stream length 256 * @return An instance of type TLVRecordType that contains the first TLV record. If tlvDataBasePtr is NULL or 257 * tlvDataLen is zero the returned TLVRecordType instance will be logically NULL, meaning TLVRecordType.isNull() will 258 * return true 259 */ 260 TLVRecordType getFirstTLVRecord(uint8_t* tlvDataBasePtr, size_t tlvDataLen) const 261 { 262 TLVRecordType resRec(tlvDataBasePtr); // for NRVO optimization 263 264 // resRec pointer is out-bounds of the TLV records memory 265 if (resRec.getRecordBasePtr() + resRec.getTotalSize() > tlvDataBasePtr + tlvDataLen) 266 resRec.assign(NULL); 267 268 // check if there are records at all and the total size is not zero 269 if (!resRec.isNull() && (tlvDataLen == 0 || resRec.getTotalSize() == 0)) 270 resRec.assign(NULL); 271 272 return resRec; 273 } 274 275 /** 276 * Get a TLV record that follows a given TLV record in a byte stream 277 * @param[in] record A given TLV record 278 * @param[in] tlvDataBasePtr A pointer to the TLV data byte stream 279 * @param[in] tlvDataLen The TLV data byte stream length 280 * @return An instance of type TLVRecordType that wraps the record following the record given as input. If the 281 * input record.isNull() is true or if the next record is out of bounds of the byte stream, a logical NULL instance 282 * of TLVRecordType will be returned, meaning TLVRecordType.isNull() will return true 283 */ 284 TLVRecordType getNextTLVRecord(TLVRecordType& record, const uint8_t* tlvDataBasePtr, size_t tlvDataLen) const 285 { 286 TLVRecordType resRec(NULL); // for NRVO optimization 287 288 if (record.isNull()) 289 return resRec; 290 291 resRec.assign(record.getRecordBasePtr() + record.getTotalSize()); 292 if (resRec.getTotalSize() == 0) 293 resRec.assign(NULL); 294 295 // resRec pointer is out-bounds of the TLV records memory 296 if ((resRec.getRecordBasePtr() - tlvDataBasePtr) < 0) 297 resRec.assign(NULL); 298 299 // resRec pointer is out-bounds of the TLV records memory 300 if (!resRec.isNull() && resRec.getRecordBasePtr() + resRec.getTotalSize() > tlvDataBasePtr + tlvDataLen) 301 resRec.assign(NULL); 302 303 return resRec; 304 } 305 306 /** 307 * Search for the first TLV record that corresponds to a given record type (the 'T' in __Type__-Length-Value) 308 * @param[in] recordType The record type to search for 309 * @param[in] tlvDataBasePtr A pointer to the TLV data byte stream 310 * @param[in] tlvDataLen The TLV data byte stream length 311 * @return An instance of type TLVRecordType that contains the result record. If record was not found a logical 312 * NULL instance of TLVRecordType will be returned, meaning TLVRecordType.isNull() will return true 313 */ 314 TLVRecordType getTLVRecord(uint32_t recordType, uint8_t* tlvDataBasePtr, size_t tlvDataLen) const 315 { 316 TLVRecordType curRec = getFirstTLVRecord(tlvDataBasePtr, tlvDataLen); 317 while (!curRec.isNull()) 318 { 319 if (curRec.getType() == recordType) 320 { 321 return curRec; 322 } 323 324 curRec = getNextTLVRecord(curRec, tlvDataBasePtr, tlvDataLen); 325 } 326 327 curRec.assign(NULL); 328 return curRec; // for NRVO optimization 329 } 330 331 /** 332 * Get the TLV record count in a given TLV data byte stream. For efficiency purposes the count is being cached 333 * so only the first call to this method will go over all the TLV records, while all consequent calls will return 334 * the cached number. This implies that if there is a change in the number of records, it's the user's responsibility 335 * to call changeTLVRecordCount() with the record count change 336 * @param[in] tlvDataBasePtr A pointer to the TLV data byte stream 337 * @param[in] tlvDataLen The TLV data byte stream length 338 * @return The TLV record count 339 */ 340 size_t getTLVRecordCount(uint8_t* tlvDataBasePtr, size_t tlvDataLen) const
